entities.summary: Baron Arthur Pavlovich von Mohrenheim was a diplomat of the Russian Empire who served as ambassador to France from 1884 to 1897 and played a leading role in arranging the Franco-Russian Alliance. He was born on 8 June [O.S. 27 May] 1824 in Moscow to a noble family from the Grodno Governorate in 1824, and after studying at Imperial Moscow University he joined the Foreign Ministry in 1845. He served in the embassies in Vienna (1851–1856) and Berlin (1858–1867) before being appointed minister to Denmark in 1867.
